sites.rationale: All five ledger lines converge on the same N-terminal extracellular position. ADRB2 has no signal peptide (UniProt P07550); the canonical sequence begins with M1 which is extracellular (topology landmark: EXTRACELLULAR 1–33). 'N-terminally FLAG/HA/SNAP tagged' for a signal-peptide-free GPCR means the tag is inserted after the initiator Met (insert_after_residue = 1), placing it between M1 and G2. Python computation confirms: residue 1 = M, residue 2 = G, TM1 starts at residue 34 (V), giving 33 residues of clearance from the TM boundary. No cysteines in the 1–33 span; glycosylation sequons at N6 and N15 are downstream and unperturbed. The strongest ledger line (PMC9681205) demonstrates both surface display and functional agonist-induced internalization, qualifying this as surface_and_function. The site is validated (not inferred) because the published tag is at this exact N-terminal junction. Multiple independent studies report N-terminally FLAG-tagged, HA-tagged, and SNAP-tagged full-length β2AR expressed in HEK293 cells. PMC9681205 is the most rigorous: FLAG-tagged β2AR was confirmed on the cell surface by live-cell TIRF microscopy and by M1 anti-FLAG antibody labeling (both 37 °C live and 4 °C non-permeabilized conditions), and agonist-induced (10 µM isoproterenol) internalization was quantified in βarr1/2 double-knockout HEK293 cells — demonstrating both surface display and preserved receptor function. PMC12214593 confirmed surface expression of HA-tagged β2AR by FACS with AF647-coupled anti-HA antibody. PMC9246501 and PMC10853676 report SNAP-tag fused to the N-terminal domain of β2AR with functional expression in HEK293 cells. PMC12962099 reports HA-B2AR-Rluc8 with surface detection by anti-HA antibody. ADRB2 (UniProt P07550) has no signal peptide; M1 is the first extracellular residue (topology: EXTRACELLULAR 1–33), so a tag inserted after M1 (between M1 and G2) is not cleaved. Computed: TM1 begins at position 34 (V34), placing the junction 33 residues from the TM boundary (well above the ≥3 minimum). No cysteines in the N-terminal region (1–33). N-glycosylation sequons at N6 (NGS) and N15 (NGS) are downstream of the tag junction and unaffected.
